notes: Approved fixed Tone Trace tonal correction. Its EQ shape follows the supplied Tone Trace model; a single global normalization offset makes Raw and Dataset Corrected level-neutral on FABIAN, while head-to-head loudness matching is handled separately by levelTrimDb.
channelCalibrationMethod: pink-weighted 80-16000 Hz at 0 deg azimuth / 0 deg elevation; equal-and-opposite gains
stereoPairCorrectionName: FABIAN HATO 0 Stereo Pair Tonal Restoration
stereoPairCalibrationMethod: Centered Stereo Pair at 90/270 degrees, Width Offset 0; pink-weighted 80-16000 Hz binaural power including head level trim, ear gains, and the final convolved/faded correction WAVs; equal-and-opposite source gains; common pair trim matches independent unit-power stereo input. Normalization is applied by fixed gain metadata.

stereoPairPostCorrection.method: full linear convolution, retain original 8640-tap window, 40 ms half-cosine fade on retained tail; no WAV amplitude scaling
stereoPairPostCorrection.normalization: Fixed runtime Stereo Pair gain metadata, including head level trim; no WAV amplitude scaling
